title: Descent representations for generalized coinvariant algebras, Theorem 1.2
author: Meyer, Kyle P.
work: Descent representations for generalized coinvariant algebras
difficulty_reason: After standard symmetric-group character formulas and descent prerequisites, the authored proof still constructs and uniquely straightens a generalized descent-monomial basis via the local dominance order and complementary partition. It computes graded traces against cycle type, compares the Schur-function and descent-tableau expansions, and proves the two inverse descent-subset summations needed to isolate each multiplicity. These explicit local straightening and multiplicity-inversion arguments exceed routine doctoral qualification calculations.
